dedupe_keys.name: building energy estimation using episcope heuristic oslo use case

description: Babak Ebrahimi and Mohamed-Bachir Belaid publish a spatial building-energy dataset for Oslo using the EPISCOPE heuristic. Released in June 2025 as Oslo_EPISCOPE.geojson, it estimates demand from construction year, building type, height and footprint. The GeoJSON is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Its building-level results can serve as demand inputs or a heuristic comparison baseline in urban energy simulations. Related catalogue record data-tabula-episcope-building-typologies covers the source typology method, while this deposit contains a specific city application. The public metadata do not establish observation dates, output units, building completeness or estimation uncertainty. Values should not be interpreted as measured energy use. The project also publishes Oslo XGBoost estimates, but equivalence of identifiers and weather assumptions remains untested. File contents were not downloaded.
